about: Made-up clients for the Rounds prototype. No real person. Names are placeholders and are stripped before anything leaves the browser. Pass times, med names and appointments are made up for the med-pass board.

clients.summary: 58, admitted after a hospital stay for a leg wound. Type 2 diabetes on oral medication. Walks with a cane.

goals.text: Checks blood sugar before meals and records it in the log independently
Keeps left lower leg wound clean and dry; dressing changes per home health schedule
Takes own medications on schedule without prompting

clients.sample_jottings:
rm4 BS 142 before lunch, took own metformin, watched him do it
L leg dressing dry + intact, says HH came yesterday
asked how to write down readings, showed him the log sheet, he did one entry himself
says knee hurts when walking, didn't want tylenol
call HH to confirm next dressing change day

clients.summary: 66, admitted after a hospital stay for high blood pressure. Uses a walker. Prefers Spanish.

goals.text: Takes blood pressure medication as scheduled, self-administered
Walks 100 feet with walker twice a day

clients.sample_jottings:
rm7 BP 138/84 HR 76 at 9am

walked to the dining room and back w walker, ~120ft, one rest
says dizzy when she stands up fast, told her to sit on edge of bed first
still needs ride set up for clinic appt thurs, told CM

clients.summary: 34, admitted after a hospital stay for a skin infection on the right arm. On oral antibiotics.

goals.text: Right arm redness and swelling decrease; reports any fever or spreading
